name: Empty Parameter
hint: This smell identifies a required block input that was left empty. The missing input may be an ordinary number or text value, a direction, a color, or a position; Scratch may substitute a default or behave differently from what was intended.
instruction: Deliberately fill every required input with a valid value or choose an appropriate menu option. Check direction, color, and position inputs especially carefully before running the script.
